Product Details: Experience the ultimate in car protection and shine with SONAX Ceramic Spray Coating. This 750ml spray utilizes innovative Si-Carbon technology to create a durable carbon layer that bonds to your vehicle's paint, topped with a thin silicone layer for a sleek, just-waxed look and feel. Offering up to 6 months of protection, this ceramic spray safeguards your car against dirt, insects, road grime, and salt while providing a stunning mirror-like shine.SONAX Ceramic Spray Coating is incredibly easy to apply, making it perfect for all detailers, regardless of experience level. Simply spray and wipe to achieve a streak-free, professional finish. The hydrophobic properties of this spray ensure water beads up and rolls off surfaces, helping to prevent water spots and making future car washes a breeze.Designed for versatility, SONAX Ceramic Spray Coating can be used on all exterior hard surfaces, including paint, plastics, chrome, moldings, and wheels. It also works as a rejuvenator for existing ceramic coatings, extending their longevity and enhancing their protective qualities.Directions for Use:1) Wash the vehicle thoroughly; complete drying is recommended but not necessary.2) Shake the bottle well before use.3) Turn the nozzle to the spray position.4) Spray the product onto a clean microfiber towel or directly onto the vehicle's surface.5) Evenly distribute on the dry or slightly wet paint.6) If colors appear irregular or the product has dried, repeat the application process.
